decisions.evidence: Taken together, the combination of tetrahydroquinoline (1), guanidine (1), piperidine (1), tertiary amide (1), sulfonamide (1), strongest basic pKa 11.0033, neutral fraction 0, QED drug-likeness 0.1836, and Labute surface area 205.9365 supports the conclusion that this molecule is not a substrate to CYP2C9.
The overall evidence therefore supports option (A): is not a substrate to the enzyme CYP2C9.
